points.text: Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in prison after being convicted of colluding with foreign entities under the national security law.
A London jury found Russell Brand guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.
California Governor Gavin Newsom commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on the state’s death row.
Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigned amid a bank crisis and lawmakers’ support for pursuing an impeachment trial.
The Bank of England raised its interest rate to 4%, citing inflation concerns linked to higher energy prices.
